fightSong.title: Motor City Beat
fightSong.lyrics: Assembly line to the goal line / Detroit music, right on time / Motown soul, techno heart / Music Machine, we do our part!

stadium.name: The Assembly Line
stadium.tradition: The Bass Drop — the stadium subs drop to 20Hz pre-game. You feel it in your chest. If car alarms go off in the lot, good sign.

fanCulture.description: They bring boomboxes (vintage). After sacks they do the robot. Motown to techno, they love it loud.
fanCulture.tailgate: Coney dogs and techno in a parking lot.

rivalries.name: The Motor City Bake-Off
rivalries.narrative: Deep dish vs Detroit style. Square vs round, forever.

rivalries.name: The Rust Belt Riff
rivalries.narrative: They have hotdish, we have hits.

paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: MUSIC MACHINE TOUCHDOWN! That's a chart topper!

cityFlavor: Cars, music, and comeback. We build things that last.
